basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Wisconsin. I love exploring the intricacies of online role-playing games, particularly Eve Online, and discussing them with like-minded individuals. In my downtime, I enjoy testing out new tech gadgets and visiting my local Culver's for some ButterBurgers. Working as a software developer, I often find myself coding late into the night, usually between 10 PM and 2 AM. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to travel and explore new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience in software development, I have a strong foundation in technology and programming. My interest in gaming led me to self-teach various aspects of computer hardware and software optimization, particularly for gaming setups. I also stay updated with tech trends through online courses and tech forums.
